description: Governance gate: assert policy over commits and report pass/fail plus violations. Read-only — reports, does not block. Use in CI to keep unreviewed AI work off a branch.

range.description: commit range, e.g. main..HEAD (default: all attributed commits)

requireAttribution.description: fail if a scoped commit has no attribution

requireHumanReview.description: fail if an AI commit lacks a human review

verifyChain.description: fail if the timeline hash chain is broken

name: board_check
